decisionsTitle: The list for sponsors, behind a notice that says the partners may receive it; the public-list tick names the results; the «Acorduri» block compacted (amending §562 and §143)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29 18:40–18:42:** «I need to be able to export the participants list but filter out just the ones who agreed to receive marketing emails so we can share it with our sponsors.» And: «"Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți — opțional" => "Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate — opțional" cuz we will also have a results list.» **At 19:03**, of a screenshot of the form's «Acorduri» block: «Also these need to be more compacted!» **At 19:33**, of a screenshot of «Acorduri» on QA after approving the notice: «trebuie să scriem tot „— opțional” la „Vreau să primesc oferte” și la lista de participanți & rezultate trebuie să punem un trofeu ca iconiță pentru consistență; de fapt pentru fiecare bifă ne trebuie și o iconiță la început» and «e destul de importantă partea asta cu acordurile!» **Amends §562** (its notice said «Le trimite numai clubul: partenerii nu primesc adresa ta»; the fold on «Newsletter»), **§143** (the tick's words) and **§550** (the same readers).

**The list for sponsors.** One read, `registrations/sponsor-list.ts#readPromoConsentRows`, is the only query of who said yes to «oferte și beneficii»: a yes (`promo_consent`) on a real registration (`kind` in no other condition, AGENTS.md §12.6) whose address is proved and which still stands — waiting for its declaration, on the waiting list, offered a place, or confirmed (§562's `PROMO_LISTED_STATUSES`, now defined there and re-exported by the newsletter) — never an unproved address, a cancelled, an expired or a test registration. `sponsorList({ eventId? })` narrows it to what a partner may receive — a yes given under a sharing notice (below) **and never a minor**: a child's name goes to no third party's marketing, whatever the guardian ticked, so the participant must be 18 on the day the list is made (`domain/sponsor-share.ts#adultForPartners`, the guardian rule's `isMinorOn` against the download's moment), and a registration without a readable birth date (one the desk entered) is left out, the safe side; §562's club list is not narrowed, since the guardian's address receives the club's own sending — and is read by both doors: «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori» on an event's registrations page (with an event chosen) and the same button inside «Newsletter» → «Participanți care au bifat oferte și beneficii» for every event. One file, `buildSponsorListCsv`: Prenume, Nume, Email, Eveniment, Data acordului (ISO 8601) — never the birth date, the phone, the health note, the declaration's facts or the address holder's other people — through `csvCell`, CRLF, a BOM; named `sponsori-<slug-evenimentului>-<zi>.csv` or `sponsori-toate-<zi>.csv`. The route `GET /api/admin/registrations/sponsor-list?event=<id>` (no event = every event; an id that is not a UUID is 400) asserts `canExportSponsorList` — `canReadRegistrations`: the Organizer, the Administrator, the Superadministrator; Tehnic, the volunteer, the Redactor and a member are refused (403) whatever the link — and writes one audit row `registrations.sponsor_list_exported` with `{ eventId | null, count, recipient | null, registrationIds }` — the ids of the registrations the file held and whom it was given to, never a name or an address. The button is a plain GET form with one optional box, «Cui dai lista (opțional)» (`to`, control characters dropped, whitespace collapsed, at most 120 characters, `sponsorRecipient`), so the club can keep the notice's promise to say which partners received a person's data (art. 15 and 19 GDPR) long after its own copy of the file is deleted: a registration's page in the backoffice reads those rows back as «Dată partenerilor» — when, to whom (or «destinatar nenotat»), by whom (`audit/repository.ts#listPartnerShares`). The count sits beside the button («N persoane», `countForm`), read by `sponsorListSummary` — the same row rule over three columns, no join, and no count while the notice in force does not describe the sharing — with one caption: what the file holds (adults only, consents given under a notice that allows it), to write whom it goes to and to delete the file within 30 days. The main registrations export is untouched: the sponsor list is its own minimal file. §562's club list on «Newsletter» keeps its table and its «Descarcă CSV» in their place, read through the same query and written by the same writer (its CSV has the five columns now), because the club's own sending is covered by every yes, the partners' only by some.

**The gate (AGENTS.md §10.8, the §396/§562 mechanism).** A new merge field `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}`, filled with the three data a partner receives in words («prenumele, numele și adresa ta de e-mail» / “your first name, last name and email address”, `Registration.promo.sharedData`), read by `describesPromotionalMaterialsShared`. `{{promotionalMaterials}}` stays the box itself, exactly as §562 reads it; the box's words do not change. The button is offered only while the notice in force names the new field in every language (`noticeDescribesPromotionalMaterialsShared`); otherwise it is a disabled button with «Nota de confidențialitate în vigoare nu spune că lista poate fi dată partenerilor.» and the route answers 409 — the page's state is the same rule, not the rule. And the list holds only the registrations whose yes was given under a text that described the sharing: `domain/sponsor-share.ts#sharedWithSponsors` asks **both** the notice the registration recorded (`privacy_notice_version`) **and** the notice in force at `promo_consent_at` (a later yes from the person's own page is given under the notice of that moment, §562) to be in the exact set of approved, not withdrawn versions that name the field in every language (`findSponsorShareVersions` — a set, not §421's lower bound, so a later version that drops the marker never lets its registrants through). A yes given under §562's «partenerii nu primesc adresa ta» never reaches a partner, even once a sharing notice is in force; a person who registered under it and said yes later under the new one is left out too, the safe side. No migration: the columns exist.

**The notice template** (both languages; the twelve sections kept; the four placeholders untouched; no text in effect changes — production keeps its approved notice until the club approves one from the template). Section 5: §562's «Le trimite numai clubul: partenerii nu primesc adresa ta…» is gone, and a paragraph «Lista pentru parteneri:» says the club may give its partners — the club's sponsors and the partners of its events, named as a category — `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}`, so they send their own offers; nothing else; never sold; the consent covers the club's messages and the partners'; a partner uses the data as a separate controller under its own notice and may be asked directly to stop; the list is given only with consents given under a version that says so; a withdrawal stops every later sharing and the club asks the partners that hold the data to stop writing and delete it; art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and art. 12 of Law 506/2004; on request the club says which partners received the data (art. 15, 19); the complaint to ANSPDCP (section 9). The paragraph also says «Datele unui minor nu le dăm niciodată unui partener: lista îi cuprinde doar pe participanții care au împlinit 18 ani în ziua în care e făcută.» and, after the art. 15/19 promise, «pentru fiecare listă, clubul păstrează cui a dat-o și ce înscrieri a cuprins.» Section 6: «Nu le vindem și nu le dăm nimănui altcuiva, cu o singură excepție…» names the partners and the field. Section 7: «Lista dată partenerilor: copia clubului, ștearsă în cel mult 30 de zile de la descărcare; la partener, cât spune nota lui de informare, iar când îți retragi acordul îi cerem să îți șteargă datele; cui am dat-o și ce înscrieri a cuprins rămân în jurnalul echipei, fără fișier.» The template's header says what changed; `/admin/legal` sees the moved template by its hash (§532) and says «Nota în vigoare nu spune încă că lista pentru sponsori…» (`legal.sponsorMissing`); the legend lists the field; `/admin/tasks` carries the open, never blocking row `sponsorNotice` with the steps, done by itself the day such a notice takes effect.

**What the person reads.** On the manage page and «Înscrierile mele», a registration whose yes may reach a partner reads «La această înscriere primești oferte și beneficii de la club și de la partenerii săi. Clubul le poate da partenerilor prenumele, numele și adresa ta, ca să îți scrie ei.» (`Registrations.promo.yesShared`); every other yes keeps §562's sentence, still true for it — and a minor's row always does. **Where the yes is given** (art. 7(2) and 13 GDPR: the information at the point of consent), while the notice in force names the new field (`cachedPromotionalMaterialsShared`, the same reading in every language), the box's caption adds «Clubul le poate da partenerilor prenumele, numele și adresa ta.» (`Registration.promo.shared`) on the form and on the declaration page, and the manage page says «Dacă îl dai, clubul le poate da partenerilor prenumele, numele și adresa ta.» (`Registrations.promo.optInShared`) beside its «Vreau» button; the box's own words do not change.

**The tick's words (amending §143).** «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate — opțional» / “I want to appear on the participants & results list — optional”, the ampersand as the owner wrote it, wherever the tick is named: the form, the manage page's and «Înscrierile mele»'s switch («Vreau / Nu vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate»), the confirmation email's link, the staff form («Persoana vrea să apară pe lista de participanți & rezultate»), the event list's note and the editor's help, AGENTS.md and BUSINESS.md. The notice's section 4 quotes the new words and its results sentence names one disclosure behind one tick: «Rezultate cu nume nu publicăm încă. Când le vom publica, vor apărea în ele doar cei care au bifat aceeași „vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate” — o singură bifă pentru listă și pentru rezultate, pe care o retragi la fel — iar această notă va spune dinainte ce arată rezultatele.» — replacing «te vom întreba separat», which contradicted the tick's new words. No FAQ template names the tick; the guide does not quote it.

**«Acorduri», compacted.** `shared/ui/consent-density.ts#CONSENT_DENSITY`, read by `CheckboxField`'s `dense`, by `ReadAndAgree` and by the density test: MUI's small box (20 px) with `CHECKBOX_TAP_TARGET`'s 12 px around it — 44 by 44, still the thumb's target (BR-REQ-041-01 criterion 6), where the medium box was 48; the label in `body2`, top-aligned, 12 px above and below; the block its own `Stack` with no gap. A row is `max(44, 24 + 20 × lines)` px, where it was `max(48, 24 × lines) + 16`: five one-line rows are 220 px where they were 304, and every line of the block is 20 px where it was 24. Each helper — the list's states, the socials', the offers' «Opțional…» — is a caption directly under its label, 4 px below the words, and the box's `aria-describedby`. The race's conditions are a regular-height button (44 px, `TAP_TARGET`) with the book glyph, as wide as its words, the small box inside it, and its hint a caption; the gate is unchanged — unread, a press on the box opens the text and does not tick it (§195, §422). No word the legal reviews fixed (§425, §556) changed; the terms sentence stays one flow, its version and clauses inline. Measured in the browser on the seeded race, a glyph on every box (the plain conditions box, the terms, the fitness and privacy boxes, the offers box and its caption): the block is 532 px tall at 320 px and 252 px on a desktop; the e2e spec holds it under 580 and 280 px, every box still 44 by 44.

**Round 2: a glyph on every box, and « — opțional» on every optional one** (the owner, 19:33). One label layout for every box of the block, `CONSENT_DENSITY.labelSx` through `CheckboxField`'s `dense`: the glyph — a 20-pixel `text.secondary` icon, the size of the site's row glyphs (§318, §521) — in its own column at the label's left edge, on its first line, 6 px before the words; a wrapped line starts under the words, never under the glyph, and each caption starts under the words too (59 px, where it was 33). One meaning, one glyph: the race's conditions the book (`MenuBook`, as on its button), the terms a document (`Description`), «Declar pe propria răspundere că sunt apt medical…» the medical case the form's health fold already wears (`MedicalServices`), «Am citit nota de confidențialitate» the shield (`Shield`), «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» the **trophy** (`EmojiEvents`, the owner's word), the socials the share glyph of their fold (`Share`), «oferte și beneficii» the megaphone (`Campaign`). Each glyph is made by the Server Component as the label's first child and `aria-hidden` — never an element passed as a prop — so a box's accessible name is its words. The glyph is no longer an inline icon nudged by hand (`verticalAlign: -0.2em`, `mr`), which is what drew the megaphone apart from its words; nothing stands between a glyph and its words now. The three optional boxes end « — opțional» / “ — optional” through one prop (`optional`, `Registration.optionalSuffix`), in the label's own flow. **The offers box keeps the owner's full stop**: «Vreau să primesc oferte și beneficii de la Brașov Runners și partenerii săi. — opțional» — the sentence is what the notice quotes through `{{promotionalMaterials}}` and what the club may already have approved, so its words do not move; and its helper loses the «Opțional.» that §562 put at its head, which the label now says: «Poți renunța oricând din pagina înscrierii tale.» The required mark is drawn by the dense label itself, after the last word (the input is still `required`, through its own slot): MUI's own mark wrapped the label in a `<div>` where an inline label lost its padding and a flowing mark fell to a line of its own. The declaration page's copies — «Am citit și accept declarația de mai sus…» (the quill, `HistoryEdu`) and the offers box of the family's signing steps — are drawn the same way, dense, the offers box with « — opțional» and its caption under it. Tests: every box in the block starts with its glyph, one per meaning; the three optional ones end with the word through the prop and the four required ones never; a render of the dense label reads glyph, words, « — opțional», and a required one carries one mark after its last word and a required input; the e2e spec checks a visible glyph in every label of the block and the offers label's text.

**Refused.** Adding the sponsor columns to the registrations export (a file that leaves to a third party must hold the minimum, art. 5(1)(c)). A lower-bound version gate (§421's documented hole). Giving a partner a yes given under §562's text, even "only the names". Renaming `{{promotionalMaterials}}` or changing the box's words (texts the club may already have approved). A separate consent box for the sharing: the owner asked for one list of those who agreed, and the notice now says the one box covers both; the box's own sentence already names «partenerii săi». Leaving whom a file went to outside the application (the first draft's choice): the notice promises to say which partners received a person's data, and the club's copy of the file is deleted within 30 days — only the audit row can keep that promise, so it holds the registrations' ids and the recipient the download named, never a name or an address. A partner's list with a minor in it, even with the guardian's yes. Dropping the offers sentence's full stop so the dash reads better: the box's words are the notice's quoted text. A glyph table looked up by name for the boxes: a public page would ship every glyph in it (§318); each page imports its one icon file per box.
changelogLine: - **«Descarcă lista pentru sponsori»** — on an event's registrations page and on «Newsletter» for every event: first name, last name, email, event and consent date of the adults who said yes to «oferte și beneficii» under a privacy notice that says partners may receive them (the new template's `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}`), Organizer and Administrator only; every download is audited with whom it was given to, and a registration's page says «Dată partenerilor»; the public-list tick reads «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate — opțional»; the form's «Acorduri» block is about half as tall, a glyph leads every box (a trophy for the list), and every optional box ends « — opțional». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given registrations that said yes to offers and benefits, when «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori» is downloaded for one event (`GET /api/admin/registrations/sponsor-list?event=<id>`) or for every event (no `event`), then both come from the one query and the one CSV — Prenume, Nume, Email, Eveniment, Data acordului, a BOM, CRLF, every cell neutralized, named `sponsori-<slug>-<day>.csv` or `sponsori-toate-<day>.csv` — holding only real registrations whose address is proved and which still stand, of participants who are 18 or older on the day of the download, never a no, a cancelled, an expired, an unproved-address, a test registration, a minor or a registration without a birth date, and never the birth date, the phone, the health note or the declaration's facts; the count beside the button is the file's row count (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a download of the sponsor list, when it is made with or without «Cui dai lista», then it writes one audit row `registrations.sponsor_list_exported` with the event (or null), the count, the ids of the registrations in the file and the recipient (trimmed, control characters dropped, at most 120 characters, or null) — never a name or an address — and the page of each registration in the file lists it under «Dată partenerilor» with its moment, its recipient (or «destinatar nenotat») and the staff member who downloaded it, while a registration in no file lists nothing (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the sponsor list, when it is read, counted or its route is asked, then the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator receive it, and Tehnic, a volunteer, the Redactor and a member are refused on the server (FORBIDDEN / 403) and a signed-out request gets 401, whatever the page drew (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the platform's privacy-notice template, when it is read in either language, then section 5 no longer says the partners never receive the address and a paragraph «Lista pentru parteneri» / “The list for partners” names `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}` (filled with the first name, the last name and the email address), the partners as a category, never sold, never a minor's data, one consent for the club's and the partners' messages, a withdrawal that stops every later sharing with the partners told to stop, the basis, the recipients on request with the club keeping whom each list went to and which registrations it held, and the complaint; section 6 names it as the one exception; section 7 carries its retention; the four placeholders and the twelve sections are kept; `{{promotionalMaterials}}` is unchanged (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the privacy notice in force, when it does not name `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}` in every language, then «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori» is a disabled button with «Nota de confidențialitate în vigoare nu spune că lista poate fi dată partenerilor.», the route refuses the file (409) and writes no audit row, no caption at the offers box speaks of partners, and `/admin/tasks` shows the open row `sponsorNotice` with the steps; and when it does, the list holds only a yes whose recorded notice version and whose notice in force at `promo_consent_at` are both approved versions naming the field — a yes given under a notice that said the partners receive nothing is never listed — and the offers box on the form, on the declaration page and on the manage page says the club may give the partners the first name, the last name and the address (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event that publishes its list, when the registration form, the manage page, «Înscrierile mele», the confirmation email or the staff form names the public-list tick, then it reads «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» / “I want to appear on the participants & results list” (the form adds « — opțional» and leads with the trophy glyph), and the privacy notice's section 4 quotes the same words and names the list and the results as one disclosure behind one tick (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registration form, when its «Acorduri» block renders, then it is its own stack with no gap between rows, every box in it is MUI's small box at 44 by 44 pixels with its label in body2 (a one-line row 44 px, a row `max(44, 24 + 20 × lines)` px), each helper line is a caption under the label's words that describes the box, and the race's conditions are a regular-height button with the book glyph that still opens the text before its box can be ticked — with every word of the terms, fitness and privacy ticks unchanged, and the whole block measured under 580 px at 320 px and 280 px on a desktop (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registration form's «Acorduri» block and the declaration page's boxes, when they render, then every box's label starts with its own `aria-hidden` glyph in a column of its own — the book for the race's conditions, a document for the terms, the medical case for the fitness declaration, the shield for the privacy notice, the trophy for the participants & results list, the share glyph for the socials, the megaphone for offers and benefits, the quill for the declaration — the optional boxes (the list, the socials, the offers) end « — opțional» / “ — optional” after their words, the offers sentence keeps its full stop and its helper no longer opens with «Opțional.», and a required box carries one required mark after its last word on a required input (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the list for sponsors behind a notice that says so, adults only, with whom it went to; the list tick names the results; «Acorduri» compacted, a glyph on every box
